title: Switch Off
intro: For the days when your body is fine and your head is not. Work, travel, exams, a bad week.
A little movement first to give your attention somewhere to go, then five minutes of box breathing, then two minutes of long exhales to actually drop you down.

good: Move slowly between the two shapes, let the breath lead
Out as you round, in as you arch
bad: Pushing into end range — nothing here should feel like effort

good: Reach one arm under the other and let the shoulder settle
Feel it across the back of the shoulder blade
bad: Letting the hips drift away from over the knees

good: Knees stacked, open the top arm and follow it with your eyes
bad: Letting the knees come apart so the hips do the turning

exercises.name: Box Breathing
exercises.note: If your mind wanders, notice it and go back to the count — that is the exercise, not a failure at it.

good: Sit upright or lie down, in four, hold four, out four, hold four
Nose breathing throughout if you can
bad: Doing it with the TV on

exercises.name: Child's Pose with Extended Exhale
exercises.note: Box breathing steadies you; the long exhale is what drops you.

good: Knees wide, forehead down, in for four and out for eight
Let the shoulders get heavier on every exhale
bad: Getting up the second the timer goes
